mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signal a tightening monetary cycle that pressures corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% MoM and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand for residential construction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where HOUST declines by more than 0.5% MoM during a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of months where INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in residential credit (RSAFS) below $500 billion signals reduced consumer spending capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where RSAFS falls below 500,000 (in millions of dollars).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signal dual economic stress from labor market weakness and monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2% MoM and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods where both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS rise by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO falls below 108.0.
